label: Synthetic sample house
made_with: Blender 5.2.3 LTS, Cycles on the Metal GPU, 64 adaptive samples, OpenImageDenoise, 1280 by 720; the scene file of the full hero walk (hero-before/scene.blend), its camera re-keyed to the walk route evaluated at 30 frames a second (the route's own function of time, whose even samples equal the 15 a second motion.json at all 4724 samples), 600 frames starting at walk time 12.333333 s, the time of whole frame 186 at 15 a second; frame k shows walk time 12.333333 s + (k - 1) / 30, so every odd numbered frame is the picture of a frame of walk.mp4 (PSNR 63 to 64 dB against the full walk's frames 186, 187, 188, 336 and 485). Encoded in two steps with ffmpeg 9.0.2. First pass: -framerate 30 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 24 -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 30 -an -movflags +faststart (8648152 bytes, 3456284 bits a second, over the 5 MiB limit of the large files check). Final file, re-encoded from that first pass to fit the limit: -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 29 -pix_fmt yuv420p -g 30 -an -movflags +faststart
measured_with: ffprobe -count_frames: 600 frames, 20.000000 s, 1280x720, h264, yuv420p, 30/1 a second, 1556890 bits a second (Sat Oct. 31st, 2026)
